title: C link: channel_mask local intersection (spec 02a 2a.2, beacon.c slice)
description: The beacon header carries channel_mask u32 (bit 0=CH0) and the spec says 'local intersection computed' — no implementation applies it. Add to lichen/subsys/lichen/link/beacon.{c,h}: lichen_beacon_intersect_channel_mask(beacon_mask, num_channels) -> uint32_t — clears bits for channels beyond num_channels (mirrors python channel_plan.validate_channel_mask: mask & ((1<<num_channels)-1), CH0 bit always preserved since num_channels>=1), plus a gate helper returning true when the intersection is nonzero. Host CTest cases: identity when beacon mask fits plan, high bits cleared, empty intersection (plan 1 channel vs mask without bit0) -> gate false. Python parity: channel_plan.py:84 validate_channel_mask already exists (reference). Rust slice: same helper in lichen-core channel_plan or tdma_beacon.
close_reason: Channel_mask local intersection landed (spec 02a 2a.2, 'local intersection computed'): lichen_beacon_intersect_channel_mask clears beacon mask bits beyond the local plan's num_channels (python channel_plan.validate_channel_mask parity: mask & (2^num_channels - 1); CH0 bit always within plan for num_channels >= 1; 32-channel plans pass through; 0-channel -> empty) and lichen_beacon_channel_gate reports whether any locally usable channel remains. Host CTest extended with 7 cases (identity, high-bit clear, 1-channel, 32-channel passthrough, zero-plan, gate true/false). Gates: ctest green under ASan/UBSan, gcc -Werror -Wconversion clean, cppcheck clean. Reviews: reviewer kimi-k3 was unavailable this round (timeouts all session) -> self-review fallback per loop protocol: parity verified line-by-line against python channel_plan.py:84-88, boundary directions checked (plan >= 32 passthrough, 0 -> empty), single pure function. Sibling: Rust slice mypf filed.
